notes.title: 海缸内容更新啦！！！Update
notes.notes:
本次更新内容： 

1、新增2个海鱼包共48种  

2、新增礁石3种，珊瑚24种  

3、新增海沙6种  

4、新增海缸壁纸20张 

5、新增海鱼收集对应的成就2个  新增海缸玩法： 出售稀有及以上品质的7星淡水成鱼，获得新的货币-贝壳。贝壳可用于购买咸水鱼缸对应的新鱼苗和珊瑚等装饰。  

This update content: 

1. Added 2 new marine fish packs with 48 species in total 

2. Added 3 new reefs and 24 new corals 

3. Added 6 new sea sands 

4. Added 20 marine tank wallpapers 

5. Added 2 achievements for marine fish collection  New marine tank gameplay: Sell 7-star freshwater adult fish of rare or higher quality to get a new currency - shells. Shells can be used to buy new fish fry and corals and other decorations for saltwater fish tanks.
